2026-07-17: removed 225436 'CRRT Filter Change', syncing with concept-dict.json. Official mimic-code treatment/rrt.sql lists 225436 but marks it dialysis_active = 0 (same as 224270 Dialysis Catheter) - it is a procedural event, not an active treatment session. `rrt` is a boolean with no active/inactive axis, so excluding the id is the faithful mapping. Measured cost: of 240 MIMIC-IV stays with a filter change, 239 already carry a core dialysis id, so exactly 1 stay is affected.

hirid._comment: 2026-07-18 fix: 10002508 (Haemofiltration) is an OBSERVATIONS variableid, NOT a pharmaid (pharma table has zero rows for it; pharmaids max at ~1,001,198). It is a binary 0/1 flag (112,901 rows / 33,190 pts; value==1 in 1,836 pts). Read from observations.variableid and map value>0 -> TRUE so the 92% explicit-0 rows are not falsely flagged. Prior mapping (table=pharma, sub_var=pharmaid, set_val(TRUE)) produced an empty column. HiRID does not separately track CRRT/CVVHD/hemodialysis subtypes.
